correctness.rationale: For N_n with [e_i,e_1]=e_{i+1}, induction forces any endomorphism determined by b=f(e_1) via f(e_i)=b_1^{i−1}S^{i−1}(b); invertibility iff b_1≠0. For a vector of height i, first nonzero coordinate scales by b_1^i and remaining coordinates are solved uniquely using the nonzero triangular coefficients; orbit iff common height and leading-coordinate quotient in H_i=(k×)^i. A k-linear point-orbit-preserving map must be lower triangular with diagonal d_i∈H_i, and conversely every such map is local by the orbit criterion. For F_q, cyclicity of q× gives g_i=gcd(i,q−1), orbit size (q−1)q^{n−i}/g_i, stabilizer g_i q^{i−1}, orbit total 1+Σg_i; local group q^{n(n−1)/2}∏(q−1)/g_i. Holds over any field for structure and all q,n≥2 for counts; nonlinear maps excluded.
